gpu_profile_and_optimization.scope: Same four candidates and full 760-trial sequence as full_subject_100k_pec_objective; 100000 estimates, ordinary trial-marginal histogram; no optimizer
notes: PyTorch live allocations exclude CUDA context/code, compiler-managed local memory, allocator reservations, and desktop usage.
Timings are unprofiled medians of three warm calls, in separate serial processes; setup and first calls are separate.
Register-cap profiling is an unsuccessful experiment, not a recommended configuration.
CSI comparison uses the existing recorded 561-trial deterministic-history/window-score workload.
Fresh sequential processes on the same GPU; warm medians exclude the first repetition and compilation.
Every candidate simulates all 760 trials; 720 are scored. No observed-window stopping or latent-history substitution.
Integer bin reductions preserve exact trial densities across repeated calls and candidate batch sizes.
Smoothed materialized comparisons permit rtol=2e-6, atol=1e-8 because weights are summed per bin instead of per estimate.
Live Torch memory excludes CUDA context/code, allocator reservations, and register-spill storage.
Smoothing one continuous outcome with optional categorical outcomes is fused; multidimensional smoothing falls back.
